title: The Flintstones
about: A Bedrock quarry worker gets a big promotion, not knowing his new boss wants him as the fall guy for a swindle.
cue: Serve the steak sliders when Dino grabs a steak off the grill.

Rare rump steak and sweet onions in soft rolls.How to make it500g rump steak2 brown onions, thinly sliced20g butter1 tbsp olive oil8 soft slider rolls4 tbsp tomato relish1 cup baby rocketCook the onions slowly in the butter with a pinch of salt until soft and golden.Rub the steak with oil and salt and sear in a very hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side, then rest it.Slice the steak thinly across the grain.Split the rolls and fill with rocket, steak, onions and a spoon of relish.Number 2 chisel cheese strawsBarney swaps his test for Fred's. Crisp parmesan puff pastry twists with tomato dip.How to make it2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beaten60g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp smoked paprika250ml passata1 garlic clove, crushed1 tbsp olive oilBrush the pastry with egg and scatter with the parmesan and paprika.Cut into 2cm strips and twist each one like a chisel handle.Bake on a lined tray at 200°C until puffed and golden.Warm the passata with the garlic and oil for a dip.RocDonald's brontosaurus friesFred eats here before Cavern on the Green.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.GrillBronto ribs at the Bedrock Drive-InFamily night at the Bedrock Drive-In. Sticky barbecue beef short ribs with crunchy slaw.How to make it1.6kg beef short ribs1 brown onion, quartered1 L beef stock250ml smoky barbecue sauce2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp apple cider vinegar1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded2 carrots, grated4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseSeason the ribs and brown them all over in a heavy pot.Add the onion and stock, cover and bake at 160°C until the meat almost falls off the bone.Simmer the barbecue sauce with the sugar and half the vinegar until sticky.Brush the ribs with the glaze and grill until charred at the edges.Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and the rest of the vinegar and serve with the ribs.Ripe old age of 38 T-bonesFred says red meat never hurt his dad. Chargrilled T-bone, garlic butter and a jacket potato.How to make it4 T-bone steaks, about 350g each4 large potatoes80g soft butter2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp parsley, chopped125g sour cream2 tbsp chives, chopped1 tbsp olive oilPrick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake at 200°C until the skins are crisp.Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley.Grill the T-bones over high heat, 4 to 5 minutes a side, then rest them.Split the potatoes and top with sour cream and chives.Serve each steak with a slice of garlic butter melting on top.SweetsConcretia's chocolate concrete slabMr Slate names it after his daughter. Dense chocolate mud cake under cookie rubble.How to make it200g dark chocolate, chopped200g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs150g plain flour30g cocoa powder125ml milk6 chocolate sandwich cookies, crushed250ml thickened cream, whippedMelt the chocolate and butter together, then stir in the sugar.Beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour, cocoa and milk.Pour into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 160°C until just set.Cool, cut into slabs and top with cream and crushed cookie rubble.DrinksBarney's lava juiceBarney raises his lava juice to Fred. Blood orange, mango and ginger beer over ice.How to make it500ml blood orange juice250ml mango nectar1 lime750ml ginger beer2 cups ice cubesStir the blood orange juice, mango nectar and lime juice together in a jug.Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the juice and top with ginger beer.Barney's ice cream truck spiderLemonade poured over vanilla ice cream.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
